title: valerianoides mutabilis
intro: Valerianoides mutabilis, commonly known as the "changeable valerian", is a species of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Valerianoides mutabilis are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to promote relaxation and calmness. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include valerenic acid, valeranone, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
